priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns a no-op disposer, while line 2 registers handler with socket.on; the diff explicitly removed socket.off("message", handler), so invoking cleanup cannot detach the listener.
